complex_queries.query: Something I can rest a hot casserole dish on in the middle of a movie night without worrying about burning or staining the upholstery.
Somewhere I can temporarily line up three laptops side-by-side where people on both sections of the sofa can look at them together.
A surface where I can set my keys and wallet as soon as I walk in the door so they’re visible but not on the floor.
Somewhere elevated and stable where I could balance a projector so it throws an image toward the wall above the long sofa.
Something soft but supportive I can sit on to face the coffee table while keeping my feet on the rug instead of the bare floor.
Somewhere to put my coffee mug that is not on anything made of fabric or cushions.
Something comfortable to sit on that is not any of the stools or ottomans.
A place to display framed photos that is not the wall above the sofa.
Somewhere I could place a floor fan that is not blocking the doorway and not on the rug.
Something rigid and elevated I could use for a board game that is not the coffee table in the center of the rug.
Somewhere I can pile up textbooks for late-night studying within arm’s reach while I’m sitting on the bed.
A stable surface where I can lay out a laptop and notebook so I can work while sitting on the edge of the bed without blocking the path to the door.
Something I can grip with one hand to help myself stand up from kneeling on the rug near the foot of the bed.
Somewhere off the floor where I can neatly fold and stack a week’s worth of sweaters.
An object I can turn on to give soft light for reading without lighting up the whole room.
A place to set my glasses at night that is not on the bed and not on the floor.
Somewhere to store clothes that is not the bed and not the floor.
Something flat and rigid I can stand on to reach the top of the window that is not the mattress or the rug.
A surface where I can place a glass of water that is not the same table as the lamp on the far side of the bed.
Somewhere to drop my backpack when I come in that is not blocking the door and not on any fabric furniture.
Something I could place a laptop on so that I can present slides to a small group sitting on the sofa while I sit nearby.
A surface where I can spread out printed handouts for a team of four people to pick up before a meeting.
Somewhere I can rest a projector so it points toward the large display wall without blocking people walking between the door and the table.
Something soft and long where two people can lounge while still facing the screens.
A place I can keep a recycling box out of the way but still near where people finish their drinks at the meeting table.
Somewhere to jot notes on my laptop that is not the coffee table and not my lap.
Something to sit on while facing the meeting table that is not the sofa.
A rigid surface for placing a hot mug that is not on the wooden meeting table and not on the fabric of the sofa.
Somewhere to stash a power strip off the floor that is not the top of the coffee table and not any chair seat.
An object I can look at to check the time that is not any of the digital screens.
A place where I can set up three laptops side-by-side so that several teammates can gather around for a quick working session.
Somewhere narrow but long where I can line up demo devices along the wall for people to browse during a presentation.
Something comfortable to sit on while informally chatting with a colleague who is standing near the coffee table.
A stable surface I can stand next to while using the large screens as a backdrop during a talk, without blocking the seating at the table.
Somewhere central where we can place snacks and drinks so both people at the sofa and at the chairs can reach them during a meeting.
A place to put the wastebasket so it is reachable from the meeting table but not blocking the path to the door.
Somewhere to rest a projector that is not on the conference table and not on the floor.
Something to sit on for a one-on-one conversation that is not any of the chairs around the conference table.
A rigid elevated surface where I can quickly place my phone that is not the coffee table and not any seating surface.
Somewhere to put a shared power strip for charging laptops that is not directly under people’s feet and not on top of the sofa.
